title: Keyboard navigation, visible focus and tab order

videos.script:
Put the mouse away and try to use the planner. {{keys}} Press Tab. Something has the focus, but you cannot see what, because a line of CSS took the ring away.

Today the keyboard gets tests. {{walk}} The first presses Tab and writes down every stop. It found that a date field is four stops, not one, which nobody had predicted.

Then three fixes, each with a test that failed first. {{ring}} A ring you can see, drawn only when the keyboard is in use. {{lost}} A focus that stays on the row you just marked done, instead of falling back to the top. {{nav}} And a focus that moves to the heading when you follow a link, but not when the page first loads.

Tab follows the HTML, not the screen. {{order}} And a button already knows the keyboard. A div has to be taught, one key at a time.

The tests cover what a machine can be told to look for. The rest is a walk you take by hand.
